segments.thag1.52:1.1: “Vassati devo yathā sugītaṃ, channā me kuṭikā sukhā nivātā;
segments.thag1.52:1.3: Cittaṃ susamāhitañca kāye, atha ce patthayasi pavassa devā”ti.

lines: Tattha subāhunā vuttagāthāyaṃ cittaṃ susamāhitañca kāyeti mama cittaṃ karajakāye kāyagatāsatibhāvanāvasena suṭṭhu samāhitaṃ sammadeva appitaṃ.
Ayañhi thero kāyagatāsatibhāvanāvasena paṭiladdhajhānaṃ pādakaṃ katvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
